# The published distribution as the blend of the published model and its direct-pairs twin (#491)

<!-- generated: blend-equal -->

**Generated by `scripts/blend_equal_491.py render` from `docs/runs/published_distribution_blend_equal_daily_h1.json`; never hand-edited.**

Each day's forecast is the equal-weight average of the published model's and the direct-pairs twin's uncalibrated quantiles, then the published conformal calibration unchanged. It was declared before it was scored in `metadata/turning_point_variant.json` and scored in #455; the approval is Eleonora, comment 6087569748 on #456 (performed_via_github_app null). Days: 2018-06-29 to 2025-12-31 only; the 2026 days and the frozen final test are not scored. The live record and the live pin are untouched. The published model's own record stays in `docs/runs/published_distribution_daily_h1.json`.

Gain is CRPS(published) - CRPS(blend) per day in bp, so a positive mean favours the blend; intervals are 90% stationary bootstraps (block length 2, 2000 replications). Intervals of the cells are not adjusted for several comparisons; only the first row is the declared test.
